stem: In paragraph 11 of the selection “Why I Write Longhand,” why does the author describe evolving computer tools as “a multi-tentacled entity”?
instruction: Use “Why I Write Longhand” to answer the following question.

options.label: F
options.text: He embraces the need for writers to multitask.

options.label: G
options.text: His addiction to computer devices has become overwhelming.

options.label: H
options.text: He believes that writers must pay attention to many things at once.

options.label: J
options.text: His experiences designing computer games impact the way he views the world.
